name: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
source: Control ids, titles and check mappings from aquasecurity/trivy-checks pkg/compliance/aws-cis-1.4.yaml (MIT) @ 3ae9f4cc196767047a2a1fdae2d24a82944dfd6b

mapping: Deterministic by rule id for checks Pepper runs on code (AWS). Other controls need a running cluster / account and are listed as not assessable from code. Controls marked mappingSource "pepper" (2.1.5, 2.2.1, 2.3.1, 3.1, 3.2, 3.7, 3.9, 5.2) are Pepper's IaC mapping, not part of the upstream spec.

controls.title: enforce-user-mfa
controls.summary: IAM Users should have MFA enforcement activated.

controls.title: enforce-root-mfa
controls.summary: The "root" account has unrestricted access to all resources in the AWS account. It is highly recommended that this account have MFA enabled.

controls.title: enforce-root-hardware-mfa
controls.summary: The "root" account has unrestricted access to all resources in the AWS account. It is highly recommended that this account have hardware MFA enabled.

controls.title: limit-root-account-usage
controls.summary: The "root" account has unrestricted access to all resources in the AWS account. It is highly recommended that the use of this account be avoided.

controls.title: set-minimum-password-length
controls.summary: IAM Password policy should have minimum password length of 14 or more characters.

controls.title: no-password-reuse
controls.summary: IAM Password policy should prevent password reuse.

controls.title: disable-unused-credentials-45-days
controls.summary: AWS IAM users can access AWS resources using different types of credentials, such as passwords or access keys. It is recommended that all credentials that have been unused in 45 or greater days be deactivated or removed.

controls.title: limit-user-access-keys
controls.summary: No user should have more than one active access key.

controls.title: rotate-access-keys
controls.summary: Access keys should be rotated at least every 90 days

controls.title: no-user-attached-policies
controls.summary: IAM policies should not be granted directly to users.

controls.title: no-policy-wildcards
controls.summary: IAM policy should avoid use of wildcards and instead apply the principle of least privilege

controls.title: require-support-role
controls.summary: Missing IAM Role to allow authorized users to manage incidents with AWS Support.

controls.title: remove-expired-certificates
controls.summary: Delete expired TLS certificates

controls.title: enable-access-analyzer
controls.summary: Enable IAM Access analyzer for IAM policies about all resources in each region.

controls.title: require-mfa-delete
controls.summary: Buckets should have MFA deletion protection enabled.

controls.title: Ensure that S3 Buckets are configured with 'Block public access (bucket settings)'
controls.summary: Ensure that S3 Buckets are configured with 'Block public access (bucket settings)'
evidenceExamples: Pepper IaC checks: AWS-0086, AWS-0087, AWS-0091, AWS-0093, AWS-0094

controls.title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled
controls.summary: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled

controls.title: Ensure that encryption is enabled for RDS Instances
controls.summary: Ensure that encryption is enabled for RDS Instances

controls.title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
controls.summary: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions

controls.title: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
controls.summary: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled

controls.title: no-public-log-access
controls.summary: The S3 Bucket backing Cloudtrail should be private

controls.title: ensure-cloudwatch-integration
controls.summary: CloudTrail logs should be stored in S3 and also sent to CloudWatch Logs

controls.title: require-bucket-access-logging
controls.summary: You should enable bucket access logging on the CloudTrail S3 bucket.

controls.title: Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs
controls.summary: Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest using KMS CMKs

controls.title: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs
controls.summary: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs

controls.title: enable-object-write-logging
controls.summary: S3 object-level API operations such as GetObject, DeleteObject, and PutObject are called data events. By default, CloudTrail trails don't log data events and so it is recommended to enable Object-level logging for S3 buckets.

controls.title: enable-object-read-logging
controls.summary: S3 object-level API operations such as GetObject, DeleteObject, and PutObject are called data events. By default, CloudTrail trails don't log data events and so it is recommended to enable Object-level logging for S3 buckets.
